title: Laptop Keyboard Replacement
description:
Computer Keyboard Replacement

At E-Tech, we provide professional laptop and computer keyboard replacement services, following standard diagnostic and disassembly procedures to ensure proper key response and long-term reliability.

All keyboards are replaced using OEM or OEM-equivalent components, tested for key travel, responsiveness, and layout compatibility.


Service Includes

• Non-responsive or missing keys

• Sticky or repeating keys

• Liquid-damaged keyboards

• Backlight or layout issues


Why E-Tech

• Experienced technicians in laptop input systems

• OEM-quality replacement keyboards

• Model-specific, ESD-safe repair process

• Typical repair time: 1–2 working days

• 3-month warranty

• No Fix, No Fee

• Free diagnostics


Professional Keyboard Replacement You Can Trust

Bring your laptop or computer to E-Tech for a precise and reliable keyboard replacement.
